svg.text: Per-amplicon coverage across cohorts: derived vs supplied panels
Each point is one amplicon (median read depth across the cohort's specimens); bar = cohort median, band = interquartile range.
Derived panels take amplicons from the coverage peaks, so coverage runs high and even; supplied panels include amplicons the reads cover poorly.
Note: absolute depth reflects each run's sequencing effort and is not comparable across cohorts; the informative contrasts are the spread within a panel type
and the same-reads Cyclospora pair — supplied median 588 vs derived median 5,464 over the identical 153 libraries.
